title: Durandus, Holcot, Pico: improper-only view rejected as rash by recent Scholastics
source_text: XL. Haec sententia tribuitur Durando, & Holcot, & Pico Mirandulano, sed communiter rejicitur a Scholasticis recentioribus, & habetur pro temeraria. Ut videre est apud Vasquezium, Suarezium, Bellarminum, Gregorium de Valentia, Puteanum, & alios, qui communi consensu statuunt imagines proprie & vere adorandas esse.
pass_a_gloss: This opinion is attributed to Durandus, and Holcot, and Pico of Mirandola, but is commonly rejected by the more recent Scholastics, and is held for rash. As may be seen in Vasquez, Suarez, Bellarmine, Gregory of Valencia, Puteanus, and others, who by common consensus establish that images are to be adored properly and truly.
pass_b_english: Durandus, Holcot, and Pico are tagged with the improper-only view.
Recent Schoolmen — Vasquez, Suarez, Bellarmine, Valencia, Puteanus — reject it as rash and insist images are adored properly and truly.

lemmas.gloss: to be adored properly and truly

choices.why: Censure grade for the older opinion.
